content: Kupwurokong kauwada imwe oh kihong uhr isipwoat.
E ahpw kemehla mahn emen pwehn kamadipwki, doaloahda mehn doal iou kei ong nan waino, oh kaunopada tehpelo.
E ahpw kadarala nah serepein lidu kan pwe re en likwer sang wasa ile kan en kahnimwo, patohwan:
“Kohdo, kumwail me sehse lamalam akan!” Oh ong ohl pweipweio e nda,
“Kohdo tungoale oh nim wain me I doaloadahro.
Kohdo sang rehn me sehse lamalam akan, oh ale mour. Idawehn ahl en loalokong.”
Ma kumwail pahn kapwungala aramas aklapalap men, kumwail pahn sarohdi. Ma kumwail pahn lupwoare aramas suwed men, kumwail pahn ale kamakam.
Dehr kapwungala aramas aklapalap men; pwe e pahn kailongkinuhkala. Ahpw ma ke pahn kapwungala aramas loalokong men, e pahn waunekinuhkala.
Mehkoaros me kumwail pahn ndaiong aramas loalokong men pahn kalaudehla eh loalokong. Mehkoaros me kumwail pahn ndaiong aramas pwung men pahn kalaudehla eh loalokong.
Pwe kumwail en loalokong, keieu kumwail pahn lemmwiki KAUN-O. Ma kumwail pahn ese Me Sarawio, eri, mie amwail dehdehki.
Kumwail me pahn wihn ma mie amwail kupwurokong, ahpw ma kumwail pahn soikala, eri, kumwail me pil pahn lokolongki.
Soaloalokong rasehng lih pweipwei oh sehse namenek men me lokaia tohto.
E kin mwomwohd nan wenihmwen imwe de wasahn mwomwohd keieu ile kan en nan kahnimw,
oh kin likilikwerih aramas akan me kin keid limwah, me kin wiewiaseli pein ar doadoahk kan,
ndinda, “Kumwail me sehse lamalam akan, kumwail kohdo!”
A e kin ndahng ohl pweipwei, “Pihl me pirapada me iou, oh pilawa pirapada me mem.”
Me dukiong sohte kin ese me irail kan me kin kohla ni imwe kin mehla, oh irail kan me pedolongehr milahr nan wasahn me melahr akan.
